title: Ukban bar Nechemyah, the Exilarch
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He lived in Rav Yosef’s time. Hyman identifies him with Natan deTzutzita, the penitent mentioned in [Shabbat 56b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.56b.19); see his entry.[^1]
In [Bava Batra 55a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.55a.3), Rabbah said, “Ukban bar Nechemyah told me these three things in Shmuel’s name.”

notes.text: The linked Shabbat identifies Ukban with Natan deTzutzita. In Bava Batra, Rabbah reports three teachings he heard from Ukban in Shmuel’s name.
